sentences.text: The petitioner is the holder of an Indian Passport bearing No. N1424498, issued on 01.09.2015 by the Regional Passport Office, Kozhikode, which was valid from 01.09.2015 till 31.08.2025.
The petitioner submits that he had applied for renewal, as seen from Ext.P3 receipt dated 12.08.2025 issued by the Indian Consulate at Dubai.

2. On an enquiry, it was found that the wife of the petitioner had lodged a complaint before the Thottilpalam Police Station, registered as Crime No.514 of 2023, alleging offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, and based on the same, the renewal application was not being processed.

The petitioner submits that he is conducting business abroad and,
2025:KER:92093 therefore, a short validity passport may be issued to enable him to travel to India and take the necessary steps in the criminal proceedings initiated against him.
3. Taking note of the fact that the petitioner is implicated in a case registered alleging offences under Sections 498A and 406 of the Indian Penal Code and that he is presently abroad, there will be a direction to the 3rd respondent to issue a passport having a validity of one year to enable the petitioner to travel to India and take appropriate steps in the criminal proceedings initiated against him, including seeking permission for travel outside the country.

Orders shall be passed by the 3rd Nelliyullathil Nizar vs Union Of India on 28 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137718510/
